transcript:
Speaker A (Bouncer): अरे कहां चले जा रहे हो? चलो बाहर चलो। लड़की के बिना एंट्री अलाउड नहीं है। [Hey, where are you going? Go outside. Entry is not allowed without a girl.]
Speaker B (Boy): Why can't I go inside? What's wrong with me? Can't a guy party without a girl?
Speaker A: अरे आप तो फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश में गुस्सा गए। कहां से सीखा इतनी अच्छी इंग्लिश में गुस्साना? [Oh, you got angry in fluent English! Where did you learn to get angry in such good English?]
Speaker B: English Seekho App se. [From English Seekho App.]
Speaker A: English Seekho App? ये क्या है? [English Seekho App? What is that?]
Speaker B: English Seekho App spoken English ka best hai, jahan ekdum basic level se word to word jodkar sentence banane se lekar advance level ki farratedar English kaise bolni hai, sab kuch step-by-step bahut hi aasan bhasha mein experts dwara sikhaya jata hai. Aur iska AI coach toh alag hi level ka coach hai, jiske sath koi bhi kabhi bhi English bolne ki one-on-one practice karke apni English ko farratedar bana sakta hai. Main toh kehta hoon tum bhi English Seekho App download karke apni English ko farratedar bana dalo aur mujhe andar jaane do. [English Seekho App is the best for spoken English, where everything from basic level word-to-word sentence building to advanced level fluent English speaking is taught step-by-step in very easy language by experts. And its AI coach is on another level, with whom anyone can practice speaking English one-on-one anytime to make their English fluent. I say you also download the English Seekho App, make your English fluent, and let me go inside.]
Speaker A: हां, जाइए जाइए। मैं English Seekho App डाउनलोड करता हूं। [Yes, go ahead. I will download the English Seekho App.]
Speaker C (Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho App.]
on_screen_text:
VIP ENTRY
English Seekho
INSTALL NOW
Disclaimer...
summary: A club bouncer stops a young man from entering without a female companion, but is impressed when the man argues back in fluent English. The man explains he learned it from the English Seekho App, which offers step-by-step expert lessons and an interactive AI coach. The bouncer lets him in and decides to download the app himself.
